name: google-flow
description: Generate images and Veo videos with your Google AI Pro/Ultra subscription through Google Flow (flow.google.com), driven by browser automation. Images are free; videos use your Flow credits.

expected_account.title: Google account
expected_account.description: Gmail address that must be signed in to Flow. Jobs stop if another account is signed in. Leave empty to skip the check.

cdp_port.title: Browser debugging port
cdp_port.description: Chrome DevTools port of the dedicated browser the plugin drives.
